what: For the mirror-refusal probe: B (co-owner) goes back into the world (Continue; its service S1 is down), opens the door at home and creates an invite (1 use); the link is read

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return 'play'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout ' + S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); if (!l) return 'no door'; const t = l.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Sharing'); return t.slice(at, at + 900) })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const m = l && /unmapped:\/\/join\?i=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+&k=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+(&o=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)?/.exec([...l.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].map(x => x.value).join('\n') + '\n' + l.innerText); if (m) { window.__invite = m[0]; return m[0].length; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); return 'no link: ' + (l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 1500) : '') })()
